column1: # <name> — Vault secret map
# Three tab-separated columns:
#     ENV_VAR <TAB> kv-path <TAB> field
# Read by vault/pull.sh (fetch into .env) and vault/check.sh (verify each one
# resolves). Paths are relative to the KV v2 mount named by VAULT_KV_MOUNT
# (default: kv), so `<name>/database` means `kv/data/<name>/database`.
# THIS FILE IS COMMITTED, AND THAT IS THE POINT. It contains names and paths,
# never values. Having it in review means every change to what this project is
# allowed to read shows up in a diff, which is exactly the thing you want a
# second pair of eyes on.
# Keep it in sync with the config module: `make check-env` fails when a
# variable is mapped here but nothing declares it, or when a required
# variable has no mapping. Drift in either direction is a broken deploy.
# Columns must be separated by REAL TABS, not spaces. Most editors will do the
# wrong thing here unless told otherwise.
# Examples — delete these and add your own:
# DATABASE_URL
# REDIS_URL
# OPENAI_API_KEY
# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
